data.summary: The homepage said both 1511 and 1527 interview questions, and 24 data models; the SQL playground said 985 questions in one place and 988 in another; the homepage counted 22 sacred texts. data.summary: About 9% of roles showed a location that does not exist (for example "San Francisco, NY"). This came from pairing the first city of a multi-location posting with the last region. A posting can name several places: the card now shows the first one, the rest are listed and searchable, and each city has one spelling.

data.summary: The inherited English meanings were found to be misaligned with the Tamil for a substantial number of verses. Examples: verse 10's Tamil is "standing, sitting, lying, walking I think of You", but its meaning described a fortified city; verses 12, 24, 25, 54 and 100 were likewise wrong. The 17 interpreted verses now carry corrected renderings built from their word-by-word breakdowns. Every other verse is labelled "Working translation — under review" instead of being presented as settled.
data.title: Abhirami Andhadhi: English meanings

data.summary: The essay was rebuilt after publication, following a source-by-source review. Income is now census and SAIPE throughout, CPI uses the published July 2026 value, property tax is modelled at 1.1%, and the headline finding changed. The article carries its own dated corrections note with the full detail.

data.summary: An inconsistency about Adaptive Query Execution was fixed in four places: "AQE cannot split what was never divided" contradicted the page's own skew-splitting material. The pages now say that coalescing merges partitions, that skew handling can split an eligible partition, and that neither rescues a uniformly under-partitioned stage. The drill count was also corrected to 39 (21 inline + 18 dedicated).
